notes.text: Valid acceptance continues atomically: use offered price, whole line, same quantity; Snew; Dnew=min(Dold,Snew), F/Q unchanged; Tnew=Snew−Dnew+F−Q. Read Order.total property, set offer ACCEPTED through data access. COD amount=Tnew; ONLINE state PAID, C unchanged, refund_amount=C−Tnew. Order stays PLACED (PC04), never auto-confirms. Any conditional 0-row/lock/write/commit failure → complete rollback†, MG01.
Persistence: loaded/saved through data access — see 4.3.2.
